• Leading digital music promotion platform [Play MPE](https://www.plaympe.com) and Destiny Media Technologies Inc. announce **Sharath Cherian** as its new CEO, overseeing the operations of both companies.
The Los Angeles-based Cherian, who has served Play MPE in an advisory capacity since early 2025, is a music industry entrepreneur and technology executive best known for founding HipHopDX, which he grew into one of the world’s leading Hip Hop media platforms before its acquisition by Warner Music Group in 2020.
